result.description: A fictional creative workstation display designed for digital illustrators, animators, and note-takers. The Quill pairs a 27-inch laminated pen display with 8192-level stylus pressure sensitivity, a matte anti-glare panel, dual quick-dial controls, and a fold-out desktop stand. It is optimized for drawing, handwriting, and on-screen annotation rather than storage or enterprise computing.
result.title: Nebula Quill 27" RGB Pen Display
